title: DuoTok: Source-Aware Dual-Track Music Tokenization for Vocal-Accompaniment Generation
abstract: arXiv:2511.20224v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-track music generation requires tokens that preserve acoustic fidelity, support sequence modeling, and maintain cross-track structure. Reconstruction-oriented codecs retain acoustic detail but are difficult to model, while semantic tokenizers may sacrifice fidelity or cross-track alignment. We present DuoTok, a source-aware dual-track music tokenizer for vocal-accompaniment generation based on staged disentanglement. DuoTok first learns a semantic audio representation through self-supervised pretraining, then shapes source-aware structure using feature replacement noise and multi-task supervision: spectral reconstruction, music source separation regularization, and an ASR head for lyric alignment. It freezes the encoder and learns hard-routed codebooks for vocals and accompaniment, while a diffusion decoder restores fine acoustic detail from discrete tokens. translated_title: DuoTok：面向人声-伴奏生成的音源感知双轨音乐分词方法
translated_abstract: 多轨音乐生成需要既能保持声学保真度、又支持序列建模、同时维持跨轨结构的词元表示。面向重建的编解码器能够保留声学细节，但难以建模；而语义分词器则可能牺牲保真度或跨轨对齐能力。我们提出了DuoTok，一种基于分阶段解耦的、面向人声-伴奏生成的音源感知双轨音乐分词器。DuoTok首先通过自监督预训练学习语义音频表示，随后利用特征替换噪声和多任务监督来塑造音源感知结构：包括频谱重建、音乐源分离正则化，以及用于歌词对齐的ASR（自动语音识别）头。该方法冻结编码器，为人声和伴奏分别学习硬路由码本，同时由扩散解码器从离散词元中恢复精细的声学细节。在多个公开基准上，DuoTok取得了有利的可预测性（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: DuoTok提出了一种音源感知的双轨音乐分词方法，通过分阶段解耦为人声和伴奏分别构建可预测的离散码本，并借助扩散解码器恢复音质，同时兼顾建模友好性、跨轨对齐与声学保真度。
